sheets.name: Approval Matrix
rows: LICHEN MANUFACTURING, INC. — Procurement Approval Matrix
PROC-MATRIX-001 v2.0  |  Effective: January 1, 2024  |  Classification: INTERNAL USE  |  Owner: Chief Procurement Officer
CISO awareness notification required. DPA executed before implementation begins.
CISO awareness required. DPA executed before implementation. ERP integration tier must be formally assigned per ISP-001 §12.2 before integration activity begins.
CISO and General Counsel must co-sign approval memo. DPA required. ERP tier assignment mandatory. Architecture review by IT Security before integration.
Full executive approval package required. Board notification if vendor will have persistent production system access. DPA required. Legal contract review mandatory.
Class B — Specialized Software Vendors (Regulated Data)
DPA required if personal data in scope. Confirm data subject categories and legal basis before execution.
DPA required. SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 attestation required for vendors handling RESTRICTED data per ISP-001 §12.1.3. NDA must be confirmed executed before information exchange.
DPA required. Enhanced security review. VP business owner sign-off on data classification memo.
Executive approval package. DPA required. Legal contract review mandatory.
No DPA required. Standard NDA / confidentiality provisions apply. IT Security notification for any system integration, even if non-regulated.
No DPA required unless personal data is inadvertently in scope — confirm at intake. Standard NDA applies.
IT Security review required despite non-regulated classification. VP sign-off required at T3 regardless of data scope.
Executive approval required. Legal must review at T4 regardless of data classification.
Class D — Professional Services (Technology / System Access)
IT Security review required for all technology professional services where personnel will have system access. DPA required if personal data accessed.
DPA required if regulated data accessed. Background check requirements for personnel with RESTRICTED data access apply per ISP-001 §6.3.
CISO sign-off on personnel access scope. DPA required. Enhanced ISP-001 §12 compliance verification.
Full executive package. All personnel with production access individually vetted by IT Security.
Class E — Professional Services (Non-Technology / No System Access)
Standard NDA / confidentiality provisions apply. No system access; no data handling review required.
Standard NDA applies. Procurement confirms no system access and no regulated data in scope before streamlined path is confirmed.
VP sign-off required at T3 threshold regardless of engagement type.
Executive approval required at T4 regardless of engagement type.

sheets.name: Vendor Classes
rows: Vendor delivering a multi-module platform that will become operationally embedded across two or more Lichen business functions or systems, with ERP integration, production data access, or workforce data in scope.
ERP modules, MES systems, demand forecasting platforms with ERP data feeds, integrated workforce management platforms

Vendor delivering a single-function software product or SaaS tool that accesses, processes, or stores regulated or personal data (GDPR-scope, CCPA-scope, HIPAA-scope, or PCI DSS-scope) on behalf of Lichen.
AI/ML analytics tools with personal data input, compliance platforms, HR software, payroll processors, SaaS tools with EU employee data
Vendor delivering a single-function software product or SaaS tool that does not access, process, or store regulated or personal data. No ERP integration. No production system access.
Internal productivity tools, non-integrated analytics dashboards, standalone design or simulation software, developer tooling with no data access

Vendor providing technology-related professional services including implementation, integration, consulting, or managed IT services, where the vendor's personnel will have access to Lichen systems or data.
System integrators, implementation partners, managed service providers, IT consultants with system access
Vendor providing professional services with no system access and no access to regulated data. Engagement is advisory or labor-based only.
Strategy consultants, non-technical training providers, facilities management vendors, marketing agencies with no data access

sheets.name: Contract Value Tiers
rows: Section 3 — Contract Value Tiers (Total Contract Value)
Includes one-time fees and estimated recurring fees over initial term. Renewals re-evaluated at each term.
Standard procurement review. Includes all implementation and professional services fees.
Enhanced scrutiny threshold. Requires VP-level business owner sign-off in addition to standard approvals.
Executive approval required. CFO and relevant EVP must co-approve. Legal must review contract terms before execution.
Note: For multi-year contracts, TCV is calculated over the full initial term, not annualized. Example: A 3-year contract at $210,000 ACV with $45,000 implementation fees = $675,000 TCV = Tier 3.

sheets.name: Fast-Track Rules
rows: NEVER eligible for fast-track regardless of contract value or prior relationship.
Regulated data in scope (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI DSS)
NOT eligible. Regulated data requires full IT Security and Legal review without exception.
ERP integration in any form (Tier 1, 2, or 3)
NOT eligible. ERP-connected vendors require IT Security ERP tier assignment per ISP-001 §12.2 before any approval path may be expedited.
ERP integration tier unassigned or pending review
NOT eligible. A vendor with an unclassified ERP integration is automatically ineligible until tier assignment is completed and documented.
NOT eligible. NDA execution must be confirmed before any fast-track determination is made. An in-progress NDA does not satisfy this requirement.
Contract value T3 or T4 (≥ $250,000 TCV)
NOT eligible. Enhanced or executive approval path required; cannot be expedited.
New vendor with no prior Lichen relationship
CONDITIONAL. Fast-track requires at minimum one prior successfully completed engagement on record in the Precedent Log. First-time vendors default to standard path.
Vendor Class C or E, T1 or T2, no regulated data, no system access beyond notification scope
ELIGIBLE. Streamlined path applies. Procurement confirms eligibility at intake.
Vendor with active SOC 2 Type II + prior successful Lichen engagement + Class B T1
CONDITIONAL. Procurement may request fast-track assessment from IT Security. IT Security confirms or denies within 2 business days.
Any open PROVISIONAL or ESCALATED item in the current onboarding run
NOT eligible until all PROVISIONAL/ESCALATED items are resolved and documented.

sheets.name: OptiChain Classification

NOT ELIGIBLE — Class A vendor; regulated data in scope; ERP integration tier unresolved; NDA not confirmed executed; open PROVISIONAL items present
No — T3 does not require executive approval. VP + SVP business owner sign-off required.
Yes — Full review + CISO sign-off required (Class A / T3)
Yes — DPA required (EU personal data confirmed). General Counsel awareness required.
Yes — CPO sign-off required at T3
Procurement — M. Osei, Senior Procurement Manager
PROVISIONAL — ERP integration tier unassigned. Fast-track ineligible confirmed. Approval path locked as STANDARD (ENHANCED) pending IT Security tier determination.

GDPR Art. 28 DPA not yet executed
DPA Legal Trigger Matrix — rows A-01, E-01
Legal to draft and execute Art. 28 DPA before any EU employee data is exchanged or system access proceeds. Owner: General Counsel.
Procurement to confirm fully executed NDA with OptiChain's legal counterpart. Information-exchange phase blocked. Owner: Procurement / Legal.

Receive and validate questionnaire; assign vendor class (Class A) and tier (T3); lock approval path as STANDARD — ENHANCED
Confirm fast-track ineligibility (six conditions); initiate IT Security ERP tier review; notify Legal of DPA requirement

Execute GDPR Art. 28 DPA; confirm NDA; flag DPA as hard blocker until executed

Compile all domain outputs; produce structured approval checklist; emit ESCALATED status

PENDING — Awaiting resolution of all three blocking items.

sheets.name: Approval Workflow
rows: Section 7 — Approval Workflow Integration (Pipeline R-01 → R-06)
Receive questionnaire; assign vendor class and contract value tier; confirm fast-track eligibility
Questionnaire received and validated complete. R-01 RESOLVED.
Determine approval path from matrix; document in onboarding record; notify domain reviewers

sheets.name: Version History
rows: Initial publication. Four vendor classes, three contract tiers.
Added Class D (Professional Services — Technology) as a distinct class following audit finding on IT services vendor reviews.
Updated fast-track eligibility rules to add NDA confirmation requirement. Added cross-reference to ISP-001 §12.1.4.

Major revision: added T4 tier for contracts ≥ $1M. Added OptiChain Classification Record section. Added AI pipeline workflow integration table. Updated fast-track rules to reference PROVISIONAL/ESCALATED status conditions.
